cv.about.title: About Me
cv.about.p1: Computer Science Engineer and Full Stack Developer with a comprehensive vision of software development. My education at UCI provided a solid engineering foundation, which I have evolved by building complete solutions with Symfony 7/8, Spring Boot 3 and modern architectures, always thinking about the final product.
cv.about.p2: I am motivated by transforming ideas into functional, clean and efficient products, taking responsibility for the entire cycle: from data modeling and business logic to the user interface and deployment. I have worked in enterprise environments (Local Development Center, 2021–2024) and on high‑complexity independent projects, such as banking queue systems (SGR-Turnos) and SaaS platforms with Stripe, OAuth2 and 2FA, where I have acted as architect and lead developer.
cv.about.p3: My technical expertise covers both backend (Java/Spring Boot, PHP/Symfony, Node.js, Doctrine ORM) and modern frontend (React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Alpine.js, Twig, vanilla JavaScript). This versatility allows me to make decisions that balance performance, maintainability and user experience, adapting to the needs of each project without losing sight of the overall vision.
cv.about.p4: I am currently pursuing a Master's in Applied Informatics to deepen my knowledge in distributed architectures and high‑concurrency systems, convinced that continuous learning is the engine that drives innovative and scalable solutions. I also configure agentic development environments (harness engineering) with terminal agents to boost team productivity.
